T445 (regression scripts must hard-fail when scratch creation fails) — CLOSED, fix in 16 scripts, seeded + null controls pass.

THE INCIDENT, from direct observation 2026-08-18 ~19:20 local, during the T369 measured suite run at e87acdd: /tmp/weizigo was absent (ten-day tmp decay). In 16 regression scripts, WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/weizigo/...-XXXXXX)" fails with the parent missing, WORK is empty, and cd "" SUCCEEDS SILENTLY (POSIX: cd with an empty operand is not an error the script sees) — so scratch-repo arms executed inside the LIVE repo. Damage, all repaired, none of it committed: (1) live docs/infra/managent/tasks.json overwritten by regression-git-commit-mine.sh:190's T282-ARM8 fixture — 2691 lines / ~117 rows replaced by 49 bytes; runtime claims for T369/T443/T444 lost. (2) .gitignore truncated by 40 lines, which let (3) a scratch-arm git add -A stage 1659 files including 1.7 GB of data/ tables, binaries and .zig-cache. (4) src/claimlint.zig replaced by a fixture (2962 lines lost from working tree). (5) docs/epistemic/CLAIMS.md gutted (1217 lines). (6) AGENTS.md +1 fixture line. (7) 21 junk fixture files created (README.md, T268/T282* bundles, docs/amendment*.md, docs/foreign|notdeclared|ok|other.md, scratch.md, src/t{c,d,e,f}_demo.txt, findings/T282H-find.json, findings/T294SEED-absorb.json, tasks.json.lockfile). The pre-commit hooks REFUSED the stray commits (the suite log's 'pre-commit: .gitignore README.md' lines were the hook refusing a scratch-arm commit in the live repo) — the T278/T282 wrapper design held the last line. Repairs: git reset; git checkout of the six clobbered tracked files; junk deleted after mtime verification (all 19:19-19:27); HEAD-committed store restored; kanban runtime state re-asserted.

DETECTION: dispatch verification failed T444 with 'task not found in store' 13 ms after the worker reported success. It remains the instrument that has not lied.

THE FIX: 17 sites in 16 tools/regression-*.sh. mkdir -p /tmp/weizigo before the first mktemp site per file; every mktemp assignment now carries || { echo FATAL; exit 2; }. regression-git-commit-mine-hook.sh's function-local new_scratch() kills the whole script by PID (exit inside $() only leaves the subshell). All 16 pass bash -n.

CONTROLS: RED is the production incident itself (unguarded code, same day). SEEDED: PATH-shimmed mktemp that exits 1 -> regression-git-commit-mine.sh exits 2 with the FATAL line, live tasks.json sha256-identical before/after, no junk created (README.md and T282-arm8-bundle.md absent). NULL: normal run rc 0, 'ALL CONTROLS PASSED', live tasks.json sha256-identical.

CORRECTION TO MY OWN T438 FINDINGS, same author, hours apart: I wrote 'the suite itself is now /tmp-free'. Overbroad. TRUE: no zig test reads /tmp (that was T438's scope). FALSE as readers would take it: the suite's sh-steps REQUIRE /tmp/weizigo to exist for scratch isolation, and their failure mode when it was missing was not red — it was catastrophically unsafe. The claim I should have written: 'no test READS /tmp; the sh-steps' scratch-dir assumption is unaudited.' This is the operator's rule again — I asserted past my evidence within hours of documenting six instances of others doing the same.

RESIDUALS, honestly open: (1) T369's measured suite run was killed mid-incident — no suite verdict yet; re-run needed now that scripts are guarded. (2) The scripts' internal cd calls still mostly lack ${VAR:?} belts; the entry guard makes the empty case unreachable from mktemp failure, but other empty-var cd paths were not audited (the inbox-loop '/docs/...' absolute-path error at line 93 came from a $WORK interpolation and is now unreachable for the same reason). (3) Whether any regression script has OTHER live-repo escape hatches (relative paths before the cd, $LIVE misuse) was not swept — candidate for the full audit. (4) tasks.json.lockfile handling under concurrent managent writes deserves a look: the wipe won a race against two legitimate writers with no complaint from either.
